Dogpile Capture.name: Dogpile Capture
Dogpile Capture.description: The user calls the pile-on, and every ally within reach hits the same opponent at once: arms, legs, tape and body weight. That opponent, even one far stronger than any of them alone, is pinned to the ground and cannot move or attack until they break free with a Quirk or someone drags the group off. Stamina: heavy.
